correctness.rationale: Directly differentiated prod_{j=0}^8(x−j) and shifted z=x−4 to obtain g(z)=9z8−210z6+1365z4−2460z2+576=h(z²), h(T)=9T4−210T3+1365T2−2460T+576. Independently SymPy-factorized h mod17 (irreducible quartic) and mod11 (linear*irreducible cubic); together 4-cycle plus 3-cycle and transitivity force Gal(h)=S4. Product y_i=64 makes sqrt-root sign kernel even. Checked g mod7 squarefree type (1,1,2,4) with irreducible quadratic and quartic: square of Frobenius contributes a weight-two kernel sign vector; all S4 conjugates generate 2^3. Hence Gal(g)=W(D4) order192. Independently enumerated 24 permutations times 8 even sign masks and counted 75 with fixed signed root, yielding 25/64 via Frobenius–Chebotarev (ramified primes finite). Contribution to c is (25/64)/(8·9)=25/4608. Not an infinite conclusion drawn from modular sample frequencies.
